query.comment: Paper property 3 for M1: a bus request is always eventually answered with a bus grant (paper 1M1S: 0:05). Leads-to: whenever M1 has a pending bus request, it is eventually granted.
Reachability only: there is at least one run in which M1 is granted the bus. This does NOT show that M1 is always granted; the leads-to query above does that.

Extra: the arbiter never uses the master-2 grant value (bit 1), and the grant register only ever holds 0 (idle) or 1 (M1). Paper properties 2 and the M2 half of 3 need a second master and do not apply to 1M1S.
Extra: memory safety of the generated model.
